sources.name: University of Ottawa International Office
sources.notes: No Events Calendar REST endpoint. Custom uOttawa CMS — needs a scraper. Highest-value target for this city.

sources.name: Carleton University International Student Services
sources.notes: Found 2026-09-09: Carleton's custom 'cu_event' post type is exposed at plain WordPress REST (/wp-json/wp/v2/cu_event), it's just not the Tribe/Events-Calendar plugin this pipeline usually looks for - a normal /wp-json/ probe would have found it (check /wp-json/wp/v2/types style endpoints for a site's own custom post types, not just tribe). The site is multisite; /go-isso/ and /isso/ both route to the same 478-event collection, scoped correctly to GO-ISSO already. ACF fields give real start/end datetimes, cost, and building+room venue - richer than most sources here.

sources.name: Algonquin College
sources.notes: The real events page isn't /events/ (that's a Future-Students recruitment page) - it's the International Education Centre's 'IEC Events Calendar', found 2026-09-09 via the Current Students page, another Springshare LibCal instance (calendar id 7448). This is the tenant that exposed the libcal date= bug (see project-his-board-generator memory) - its /ajax/calendar/list ignored monthly=true and returned 0 until the per-day call pattern was used.

sources.name: Ottawa Community Immigrant Services Organization
sources.notes: Major Ottawa settlement agency. /wp-json/tribe 404s; calendar implementation not yet identified. Re-checked 2026-09-09: the /events-calendar/ URL now silently redirects to the homepage (200, but lands on /) - the page was retired without updating the site's own 'Upcoming Events' nav link, which points at the same dead URL. No events content exists anywhere on the homepage either (just non-dated 'Update' news items). This is a content/site gap, not a feed we failed to find - there's currently nothing published to scrape.

sources.name: Catholic Centre for Immigrants Ottawa
sources.notes: Settlement and newcomer programs. No Events Calendar REST endpoint. Re-checked 2026-09-09: real newcomer content (Canadian Taxes 101, Banking System 101, Workplace Culture, Navigating Social Assistance...) but the Sept-Oct calendar currently shows zero upcoming events - only a 'Past Events' list. Platform is Elementor + JetEngine dynamic listings with auto-generated per-element hash CSS classes (elementor-element-<hash>) that regenerate whenever the page is re-saved in the editor - too fragile to build a scraper against with nothing live to validate it, revisit once they post future dates.

sources.name: City of Ottawa festivals and events
sources.notes: Marquee free events entered by hand until a feed is confirmed.

sources.name: Ottawa Tourism events
sources.notes: Found 2026-09-09: real URL is /en/event-calendar (not /en/events, which redirects here anyway). Drupal Views infinite-scroll card grid, paginated ?page=N. A network call to a Cloud Run backend (mpc-prod-*.a.run.app/events) is visible but 'Resource not found' on direct access - the content is already server-rendered into the page HTML regardless, so the card grid is scraped directly instead of chasing that API further. No time-of-day or cost shown on cards - cost defaults to 'Paid' to avoid a false free-cost credit on ticketed festivals/shows (same reasoning as ticketmaster).
